name: CFG Megapack seven-stage plan
plain: A framework that splits a guided step into stages: when to guide, a weak branch, how to combine, where to guide (bands or regions), magnitude correction, an angle governor, and measurement. Each stage has a node that writes to a plan stored in model options; paper nodes write the same plan. All guidance goes through one runtime.
math:
Runtime guided_x0(x, x̂_c, x̂_u, σ, s):
1 when: w = schedule_value(shape, s, progress, t, ...), floor, inside-window test; outside: cond, plain, fixed scale, or rest of chain.
2 weak: x̂_w = perturbed_prediction (attention, skip, blur, shuffle), mode add or replace.
3 combine: registry function in its native space via to_space/from_space.
4 where: split_bands or region_map weights.
5 correct: apply_correction(spec, d, d_c, d_u).
6 govern: govern_angles keeps the angle to home within [min_deg, max_deg].
7 measure: step_stats, ProbeWriter.

props.params: see nodes CFGWhen, CFGWeakPerturbed, CFGMixScale, CFGMixDirection, CFGMixPentachoron, CFGWhereBands, CFGWhereRegion, CFGCorrect, CFGGovernAngle, CFGProbe, CFGReadout, CFGClear

surprise: It is a monolith that can reproduce many other nodes, so the same names here (APG, FDG, SMC) are reimplementations against papers, not forks of the ComfyUI nodes.

audit.note: Weak-branch list is off: the stage offers pag (identity attention), seg (blurred queries), temperature and skip (AbstractEyes__comfy-cfg-megapack/cfg_megapack/engine.py:260-261, 300-308). There is no shuffle method in the weak stage; "shuffle" appears only in a caller note for one combiner (cfg_variants.py:3542). Temperature is omitted. Otherwise the stage order and functions match engine.py:869-1070.
